brief:
Israeli forces carried out extensive pre-dawn invasions across the occupied West Bank on Wednesday, IMEMC News reported. The operations involved breaking into homes, abducting residents, and demolishing houses and residential buildings in multiple locations. The raids occurred as illegal paramilitary Israeli colonizers launched separate attacks on Palestinians in the territory during the same period.

The operations represent a continuation of military activity across the West Bank. Israeli forces have conducted similar raids and demolitions repeatedly in recent months as settlement expansion and security operations continue. The specific number of residents abducted, homes destroyed, and scale of colonizer attacks were not immediately available.
